name: kxcpicore
title: Will September 2026 core CPI (seasonally adjusted, m/m) increase above the threshold?
settlement: Resolves YES if the seasonally adjusted CPI for All Urban Consumers: All Items Less Food and Energy for September 2026, as published by BLS, increases by above the stated threshold (e.g., 1.0%, 0.9%, etc.). The value used is the single-decimal month-over-month percent change reported by BLS; a government shutdown delaying the release extends the expiration date.
decideContext: You are estimating how a news item shifts expectations for the seasonally adjusted month-over-month percent change in core CPI (all items less food & energy) for September 2026, as it will be reported by BLS to one decimal place; the market resolves YES if that printed value is above the strike threshold.
